name: OpenVINO documentation

OpenVINO is an open-source toolkit by Intel for deploying high-performance AI solutions across cloud, edge, and AI PCs. Supports generative and conventional AI models. Provides OpenVINO Base Package, OpenVINO GenAI, OpenVINO Physical AI, and OpenVINO Model Server. Documentation at docs.openvino.ai.
